title: AI替代先砍入门岗：编程会计初级律师，新人挑战更大？
speaker: Unknown

segments.en: How have you started to extrapolate what this means for jobs? The AI disruptions, right? Just given that the economy is quite reliant. The gig economy you talked about delivery and the like. The platforms.
segments.zh: 你如何推断这对就业意味着什么？AI的冲击，对吧？考虑到经济相当依赖。你谈到的零工经济、配送等。平台。

segments.en: Could the displacement of labor be much more pronounced in China than the rest of the world, do you think? Yeah, I think globally what you see is, even though we saw a lot of impact on the individual tasks, I mean, every day we use AI,
segments.zh: 你认为中国的劳动力替代会比世界其他地方更明显吗？是的，我认为全球来看，尽管我们看到对个体任务有很大影响，我的意思是，我们每天都用AI，

segments.en: but we didn't see on the aggregate level a huge displacement yet. There are different theories about why it happened like that.
segments.zh: 但在总体层面，我们还没有看到巨大的替代。关于为什么会这样，有不同的理论。

segments.en: One reason is that, you know, you have many different tasks. Some of the tasks can be easily replaced, but the whole of the job is harder to replace.
segments.zh: 一个原因是，你知道，你有许多不同的任务。有些任务很容易被替代，但整个工作更难被替代。

segments.en: But in certain industries, in certain sectors, for example, coding or accounting or junior lawyer job, it's much easier to replace.
segments.zh: 但在某些行业、某些部门，例如编程、会计或初级律师工作，更容易被替代。

segments.en: That's also happening in China in America. Not senior lawyer jobs. It's not senior job. It's actually happening, you know, I think for people entering the job market, it's much more challenging.
segments.zh: 这在中国和美国都在发生。不是高级律师工作。不是高级职位。实际上，我认为对于进入就业市场的人来说，挑战更大。

segments.en: So that's a global phenomenon, but not on the aggregate level, those people who already have the job. The senior they are, I think for now, I think it's safe.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个全球现象，但不是在总体层面，那些已经有工作的人。他们越资深，我认为目前是安全的。

segments.en: But I don't know, I mean, you know, it's hard to predict what's going to happen for the job creations. Yeah.
segments.zh: 但我不知道，我的意思是，很难预测就业创造会发生什么。是的。
